display_long_description:
READ THIS BEFORE PLAY

This is a hands-only game. Mechanics are completely different from what you’ve seen before. Have you ever driven a car in your life? You will most certainly feel discomfort at first. Be ready for this.

GAMEPLAY
You can’t just smash everything like in regular Quest games. Rare and legendary collectibles are almost always difficult to get.
If you see spikes, you will most likely get paralyzed by contact with them. You can still collect the object if you perform a precise strike while avoiding the spikes, or learn its pattern and grab it when it appears without spikes.

Legendary collectibles become obtainable with rhythm spikes - when the beat rises, that’s your moment to strike.

If you get paralyzed in different scapes, you can recover almost immediately by performing circular motions with both hands.

Inside your palm menu, under the scape switch buttons, you will see your name and status (“online”). This is where your result at the end of the scape is compared with other players.

To unlock more scapes check the daily goals inside the statistics interface, which can be opened by clicking the button on the right in your palm menu.

Don’t move chaotically. You will build up fatigue, which slows down laser growth, increases paralysis duration (5–15 sec), and reduces the amount of Llirium (your final score).

Sorry if you feel annoyed by the mechanics - the goal of Thetascape is to challenge ordinary patterns,  show something new and unique.
